defaultAudience: ADULT_SELF; school/minor use requires population-specific review
reportPolicy: Descriptive feedback only. No diagnosis, percentile, low/medium/high bands, selection or ranking.
title: Rosenberg自尊量表（中文研究译稿）

rights.verification: Official indexed source explicitly public domain and translation/adaptation permitted; direct page retrieval returned 502/503. PhenX official full protocol independently accessible.

instructionZh: 下面是一些关于你对自己总体感受的陈述。请根据你的实际感受，选择你对每句话的同意程度。
timeframe: general feelings about self; no 2-week window

items.en: I feel that I'm a person of worth, at least on an equal plane with others.
items.zh: 我觉得自己是一个有价值的人，至少与其他人同样有价值。

items.en: I feel that I have a number of good qualities.
items.zh: 我觉得自己有不少好的品质。

items.en: All in all, I am inclined to feel that I am a failure.
items.zh: 总的来说，我倾向于觉得自己是个失败者。

items.en: I am able to do things as well as most other people.
items.zh: 我做事情能和大多数其他人做得一样好。

items.en: I feel I do not have much to be proud of.
items.zh: 我觉得自己没有多少值得自豪的地方。

items.en: I take a positive attitude toward myself.
items.zh: 我对自己持积极的态度。

items.en: On the whole, I am satisfied with myself.
items.zh: 总体而言，我对自己感到满意。

items.en: I wish I could have more respect for myself.
items.zh: 我希望自己能更尊重自己一些。

items.en: I certainly feel useless at times.
items.zh: 有时候，我确实觉得自己没有用。

items.en: At times I think I am no good at all.
items.zh: 有时候，我觉得自己一无是处。

scoring.implementationNote: Response values explicitly code SD=0,D=1,A=2,SA=3. This reverses displayed option order vs PhenX but preserves exact scores. PhenX column numbers 1–4 are not score weights. Do not mix with alternate item order starting On the whole.

thresholdEvidence.note: Official FAQ says no discrete high/low cutoffs. Do not activate <15 or 15–25 bands.

populationEvidence.originalSample: 5,024 high-school juniors/seniors from 10 New York State schools; original Guttman scoring
populationEvidence.phenx: Self-report adolescent/adult; working group recommends down to age10. This does not validate this project Chinese translation at those ages.

translationNotes: Independent project translation, not copied from an unlicensed Chinese validated form.
Item8 retains negative valence as official; do not change to positive scoring because of reports about cultural wording.
PhenX offers Chinese worksheets but they have not been retrieved or adopted in this package.
No original English or Chinese local norm activated.

references.citation: Rosenberg, M. (1965). Society and the Adolescent Self-Image. Princeton University Press.
Rosenberg, M. (1989). Society and the Adolescent Self-Image (Rev. ed.). Wesleyan University Press.

references.role: Directly inspected authoritative full English items, order, scoring and protocol

reportDraft.heading: 你的总体自我评价
reportDraft.summary: 本次结果反映你对自身价值的总体感受，不是在评定你这个人有多好，也不是心理诊断。
reportDraft.scoreExplanation: 总分范围0–30，得分越高表示本次自报的总体自我价值感越高。本研究译稿没有已验证的中国人群常模，因此不提供高低等级、百分位或风险判定。
reflection: 哪些经历最容易影响你对自己的看法？
除了成绩、工作表现或他人评价，你还看重自己的哪些品质？
actions: 记录一件你认真投入或关心他人的具体小事，不用把它与别人比较。
把一次不顺利描述为具体情境和可改进的行为，而不是对整个人下结论。
reportDraft.limits: 该报告为项目原创描述性反馈；未做中文版等值验证，不用于诊断、选拔或贴标签。
